programme.title: Department Overview - Computer Science and Engineering (컴퓨터공학부)
programme.degree: Bachelor's programme of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (컴퓨터공학부), College of Engineering; 4 years; academic year starts in March
programme.how_found: Search (official domain only) -> cse.snu.ac.kr/en (department site) -> About -> Department Overview; en.snu.ac.kr Academics -> Programs -> Undergraduate lists 'Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering' with an 'English-taught Courses' link.
programme.notes: Computer Science and Engineering counts as CS (owner ruling). Language: the university lists English-taught courses per department but the programme is mainly Korean-taught; no verbatim language-of-instruction quote found, so none drafted. kb_top100_list.json has official_domain null for this row; the drafts use snu.ac.kr (en.snu.ac.kr, cse.snu.ac.kr), the university's own domain. The hosts reset the connection intermittently from the expert container (TLS SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL / connection reset); every page below was read on a retry.

english.quote: [English] TOEFL iBT 80 (a score of 4.0 for tests taken on or after January 21, 2026) OR IELTS Academic Band Score 6.0 OR TEPS 269
english.notes: 2027 Spring Undergraduate Admissions Guide for International Students, 'Minimum criteria for Korean or English language proficiency scores': Korean OR English proficiency is required ('[Korean] TOPIK (or TOPIK IBT) level 3 OR completion of a level 4 at language centers in Korean universities'). Scores obtained on or after July 9, 2024. No per-section minimum.

gpa.notes: No grade minimum published in the 2027 Spring international guide; document-based selection (transcripts, personal statement, recommendation).

deadline.quote: Online Application ✼ Monday, July 6, 2026, 10:00 - Thursday, July 9, 2026, 17:00
deadline.notes: Spring 2027 (March 2027 entry) international undergraduate round; times in Korea Standard Time. Also on the notice https://en.snu.ac.kr/admission/overview/notice?md=v&bbsidx=170606. SNU 'offers international admissions for both the spring and fall semesters' (en.snu.ac.kr/admission/undergraduate/application) but no Fall 2027 guide is published yet; this round has already closed.

value.population: international first-year admits (all students of the college)

tuition.notes: Korean section, '부록 2 신입학기 등록금 일람표 (2026학년도 기준) (단위: 원)': tuition of the entering semester, College of Engineering, all departments, based on academic year 2026. Not multiplied.

scholarship_exists.quote: Full tuition exemption and 600,000 KRW per month of living expenses
scholarship_exists.notes: For admitted students; 'Subsidized period: maximum of 8 semesters'; application periods January and July; selection by SNU Office of Global Affairs then Samsung Foundation: competitive. Also listed: Global Korea Scholarship (government, via embassies, https://en.snu.ac.kr/admission/undergraduate/scholarships/before_admission).

scholarship_international.quote: International students from developing countries in the DAC list of ODA Recipients
scholarship_international.notes: Eligibility of the Glo-Harmony Scholarship: international students, restricted to countries on the DAC list of ODA recipients.
